input_summary: Learner has Excel and customer service skills and wants a simple first step.
output_style: Use short sentences, one clear action, no jargon.
ideal_response: Start with one data skill. Check the course page. Practise one small task before enrolling.

input_summary: Learner asks why the app selected a pathway.
output_style: Explain role fit, skill gap, confidence, and caveat in plain English.
ideal_response: This path fits because it uses skills you already have and builds the highest-priority missing skill first. Check the provider before enrolment.

output_style: Mention planning estimate, free practice, subsidy check, and provider verification.
ideal_response: Try a free practice task first. Then compare the lowest-cost course and ask the provider about subsidy and SkillsFuture Credit.

input_summary: Learner only has two hours this week.
output_style: Break the plan into tiny timed steps.
ideal_response: Use 20 minutes to check the course, 60 minutes to practise, 30 minutes to reflect, and 10 minutes to choose the next step.

input_summary: A helper is supporting someone who may struggle with forms or reading.
output_style: Give a respectful script and avoid pressure.
ideal_response: Read the recommendation aloud. Check time, cost, and travel together. The goal today is one clear next step, not enrolment pressure.
